description: CardputerZero metronome with adjustable tempo, time signatures, subdivisions, tap tempo, and audible beats.

store.summary: A keyboard-driven metronome with tap tempo and audible beats.
store.description: Set any tempo from 20 to 300 BPM, choose the meter and subdivision, tap in a tempo, and follow the beat on a five-icon indicator. Click sounds can be accented, muted, or adjusted in volume. All settings persist across restarts.

zh-CN.summary: 支持速度调节、拍号、细分与敲击测速的键盘操作节拍器。
